league: Runes of Aldur or Forbidden Rites (not stated)
summary: Dusk Ring ilvl 79 with four attack flats (fractured T1 fire, T1 lightning, T2 cold, T3 physical) at 40% Attack quality.

steps: Buy normal Dusk Rings ilvl 79+ (75 'ideal', he picks 79) (~1 ex each); annul to one mod and Chaos spam for any T1 flat (1 in ~162 incl. physical)
Sinistral + Greater Exaltation + Exalt to fill prefixes, desecrate a blocker, Fracturing Orb on the T1 non-physical flat (he hit 2 of 8 rings)
Blocker bone per fracture attempt: type not stated, Preserved Collarbone assumed (3 per success at the nominal 1 in 3)
On the fractured ring annul to one mod, Chaos spam (~160) for a second T1 elemental flat
Exalt a junk suffix, Essence of the Breach + Dextral Crystallisation for the quality mod
Reaver catalyst to 40%, Sinistral + Catalysing Exaltation + Perfect Exalt (landed T3 physical)
Re-quality to 40%, Omen of Whittling + Chaos to move the quality mod out
Sinistral Necromancy + Abyssal Echoes + Ancient Collarbone, Omen of Light + Annul loop (~10 desecrations) for the fourth flat; settled T2 cold
Catalyst counts assume ~1% quality per catalyst: Reaver to 40% twice (before the catalysed slam and before the whittle)
Not costed here (no planner target): Swift Alloy attack speed via Dextral Crystallisation and the final Perfect Exalt (intelligence)
